request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Pre-Med Society is putting on our Health Fair, an event offering free health screenings and talks from medical students. It is open to USC students who want to learn more about taking care of their health. We are writing to ask whether you might be able to help with an in-kind sponsorship of first-aid kits and water. Having these on hand would help the students who come feel looked after, and would let our volunteers focus on the screenings and conversations that make the day useful. We would be glad to share more about the event and answer any questions you have.","contains_instructions":false}
